headline: Make release inspection safe and recovery evidence accurate

items.title: Make build-check help safe to inspect
items.insight: Current main has no help guard; isolated reproduction will distinguish help from sanitizer execution before repair. Reuse cli-contract help before every operational branch. Extend isolated process fixtures with spawn tripwires, byte snapshots, flag precedence and normal/self-test controls.
items.evidence: Both help aliases print documented options without sanitizing, spawning, locking or changing receipts; normal and self-test lanes remain operational.

items.title: Observe file changes in merge closeouts
items.insight: Live readCommits sees200 commits but the real SIL merge anchor has no paths in default git log --name-only output. Observe merge file changes explicitly using Git diff semantics, retaining complete anchor-bounded history and fail-closed behavior. Prove real merge, ordinary closeout and later unrecorded work with temporary Git repositories.
items.evidence: Real merge closeouts produce an observable SIL anchor; subsequent substantive work still becomes debt; live S407 triage can be measured without inventing recovery.
